scope_notes: V5: The new question requests timing and simultaneous reveal under a supplied attributed-clarification assumption. It does not require the answer to repeat the attribution, explain a documentary gap, prove adoption, or characterize the step as an erratum.

Five semantic units distinguish two prerequisite ordering relations, simultaneous all-player reveal, and two following-stage ordering relations. They are not five independently required utterances; a concise complete sequence can supply all of them. The count comes from the literal asks, not the three raw key-record count.

Keep all players, chosen sheets, unused-sheet returns and before-deck/before-hand ordering. Do not import first-player selection, flare mixing, alien-selection quantities, additional revised content or a separate physical flip instruction.

Preserve the ordinary equivalence rule: a complete appropriate operative quotation in the same answer may supply lookup facts. Material wrong conclusions or guesses still count regardless of confidence or accompanying correct quotations.
